items.title: ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-D (H4 diagnostic, corrected denominator): context-conditioned (reef vs open) committed-class TV-divergence, ARM_ON vs ARM_OFF -- supersedes V3-EXQ-847
items.note: arc_062_conversion_fanout_2026-07-29.md Section 2 Leg P-D (H4: measurement aliasing) + the 2026-08-02 active_frac denominator sweep addendum. SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-847: chip chip-20260802-v3exq847a-queue, redesign of V3-EXQ-847 per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-847_2026-08-01.md (confirmed, governance-ratified 2026-08-01T22:24:00Z). BUG FIXED: 847's mech448_demotion_lever_live_and_excluding_both_arms / mech449_active_nogo_live_and_suppressing_both_arms readiness preconditions computed active_frac = fresh-only-numerator / n_p2_ticks (ALL P2 ticks incl. held/replayed commitments) -- a basis mismatch that deflated active_frac by the held-tick fraction (40-86% across 847's 6 cells) and produced a FALSE substrate_not_ready_requeue self-route even though MECH-448/449 were actually 100% active on genuine fresh selections (847's own manifest recomputes to exactly 1.0 against n_p2_ticks - n_latched_ticks). FIX: both demotion_active_frac and nogo_active_frac now divide by n_p2_fresh_select = n_p2_ticks - n_latched_ticks, matching sibling script V3-EXQ-859's reference-correct pattern. Purely a post-hoc aggregation fix; training loop / RNG seeding / env dynamics / ARMS / hyperparameters unchanged from V3-EXQ-847. SEED SET UNCHANGED [42, 43, 44] (deliberate, investigated this build -- see script docstring PREMISE CORRECTION section): no third documented-good seed exists to substitute for degenerate seed 44 (a standalone env probe this session confirmed the seed-44 degeneracy is a TRAINED-POLICY property, not raw env geometry, so an untested seed cannot be cheaply pre-verified); seeds 42+43 alone satisfy C1g's majority-of-3 floor; extra seeds were not added since MIN_SEEDS_FOR_PASS/TV_MIN_LIFT_SEEDS are fixed absolute counts, not proportions, so adding seeds without rescaling would silently loosen every C1 subgate's majority semantics. EXPECTED OUTCOME (stated in advance): because the fix is aggregation-only and seeds/config are unchanged, this run is expected to reproduce 847's own already-known DVs (seed 43 bit-identical washout across arms, seed 44 zero reef ticks/self-excludes, seed 42 the only informative cell showing a lift OPPOSITE H4's hypothesis) -- verdict likely FAIL / non_contributory / context_divergence_not_greater_arm_on_measurement_aliasing_ruled_out. The point of this re-run is to let the readiness gate correctly recognize MECH-448/449 as live so the pipeline computes the C1/C2/C3 verdict end-to-end itself, rather than the correction living only as a hand-annotated autopsy note. Smoke (--dry-run, seed 42 only): confirmed the fix -- f_eligibility_demotion_active_frac / go_nogo_active_frac read 1.0 (28 fresh / 28 fresh, excluding 24 of 52 P2 ticks as latched) vs the old deflated ~0.538 that would have failed the 0.8 floor; demotion_non_vacuous / nogo_non_vacuous both True at toy scale. C1/C1g/C2 still read False at dry-run dose, as expected (1 seed of 3, toy episode budget -- same documented dry-run behaviour as V3-EXQ-847 itself). GOV-REUSE-1: the H4 primary DV was already reanalyzed by hand from 847's manifest in the autopsy (no re-run needed for THAT); this run exists so the corrected readiness gate + full C1-C3 pipeline runs natively, per the autopsy's own routing recommendation.

items.title: ARC-005 precision-only decoupled ladder, CALIBRATED: does the dACC goal-readout channel route precision once dacc_goal_readout_weight/normalize are actually set? (successor to V3-EXQ-848)
items.note: Bug-fix/calibration lettered successor to V3-EXQ-848 (ARC-005 precision-only decoupled ladder, FAIL/mixed 4/10 units, rho up to 0.866). 848's _agent_kwargs() never set dacc_goal_readout_weight, so it silently defaulted to 0.0 and the SD-057 L7 dACC goal-readout term (ree_core/cingulate/dacc.py DACCtoE3Adapter.forward(), gated on grw!=0.0) contributed EXACTLY ZERO to score_bias throughout 848's run -- the channel-1 dACC-consume pathway 848 was designed to test was never engaged; 848's observed signal is attributable to channel 1's pre-existing serotonin pathway and channel 2, not the dACC-consume mechanism. A follow-up direct probe (session IGW-20260801-199 / arc005_dacc_adapter_goal_proximity_training, instrumenting REEAgent.select_action on 848's own driver config) found this gap plus a units/calibration mismatch in raw candidate_goal_proximity (small achieved cross-candidate spread ~0.003-0.03 vs full [0,1] nominal range, because GoalState.goal_proximity()'s MSE-sum distance is dominated by the larger e2_world_forward candidate-summary norm rather than genuine goal-relative displacement -- a calibration issue, not an untrained consumer; DACCtoE3Adapter has no nn.Parameter anywhere). Both fixed on ree-v3 main commit 4b79d18d44 (SD-057 L7 amend): DACCConfig.dacc_goal_readout_normalize (new, default False, bit-identical off) does a per-candidate-set min-max rescale before the existing dacc_goal_readout_weight multiply. This successor sets dacc_goal_readout_weight=0.5 (V3-EXQ-637 precedent value) and dacc_goal_readout_normalize=True; every other design element (channel-1/2-only ladder, channels 3/4 fixed at L0, content sets, arena, schedule, seeds, the pre-registered C_PRECISION_MONOTONICITY criterion and its thresholds) is UNCHANGED from 848. Adds a build-time guard (asserts cfg.dacc_goal_readout_weight/normalize threaded through REEConfig.from_dims correctly, and agent.dacc_adapter.config carries them) plus a whole-run engagement check (agent.dacc_adapter._n_bias_calls must increment at least once across the run) specifically to prevent a repeat of 848's silent-zero failure mode. Substrate readiness: SD-057 IMPLEMENTED (ree-v3/CLAUDE.md); the L7 wiring fix is on main. Re-derive brake checked: 0 substrate_ceiling autopsies tag ARC-005 -- not braked. GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readout (precision monotonicity with the calibrated dACC goal-readout channel genuinely engaged) does not exist in any recorded manifest -- 848's manifest ran with the channel silently inert, not a compatible substrate_hash for this question; not recoverable by reanalysis. supersedes: V3-EXQ-848 per the EXQ lettering convention's bug-fix rule, though 848's manifest evidence is not discarded -- see the script's SUPERSEDES_NOTE for why governance review should read both results together rather than treat 848 as invalidated outright. Smoke --dry-run PASS (12 cells at dry scale): all verdicts PASS, z_goal_stream active_frac=0.130 writer_calls=600 -- no writer defect, build-time guards held, total_dacc_bias_calls=492 (engagement check passed), result at dry scale is a near-zero null (all_near_zero_null=true) -- not scored at dry scale, informative only that the pipeline runs end-to-end without error. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings across all checks.
items.supersedes_note: Bug-fix/calibration lettered iteration correcting 848's omitted dacc_goal_readout_weight (silently defaulted to 0.0, so the dACC goal-readout term never engaged in 848's run) and adding dacc_goal_readout_normalize=True (ree-v3 commit 4b79d18d44). Same design, same criterion as 848 otherwise.

items.title: SD-076 diagnostic REDESIGN: wci_symmetric_rv_ref/rv within-episode trajectory crossover, decoupled from CausalGridWorld's own episode termination (corrects V3-EXQ-864)
items.note: REDESIGN of V3-EXQ-864, per its own confirmed autopsy (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-864_2026-08-01.md/.json). 864's sweep of STEPS_PER_EP in {200,500,1000} was inert: CausalGridWorld's own episode termination (agent_health<=0.0 or steps>=500, causal_grid_world.py:2892) fired at ~8-11 ticks/episode in this driver's env config, so diff_final and all end-of-episode readouts were bit-identical across all three swept values in both arms/seeds -- the sweep never varied real exposure. DESIGN FIX (full reasoning in the script's module docstring): the per-episode inner loop no longer breaks on env-reported done=True. Verified safe by direct source read: CausalGridWorld.step() computes done fresh every call with no special-casing of post-death ticks; harm_signal (the per-tick PE-generating signal both the inflated and counterfactual EMAs consume via update_residue->e3.post_action_update) is computed identically whether or not agent_health has already floored; neither REEAgent nor StepHarness gates on agent_health; agent_health recovers via ordinary resource contact same as pre-death; the internal steps>=500 cap's only other effect (body[9] observation feature saturating at 1.0) is bounded and harmless. This realizes both of the autopsy's own suggested repairs (disable agent-death termination + raise/ignore the internal step cap) through one mechanism, with the SAME hazard dynamics and SAME agent (no extra pretraining, no reduced-hazard env, no env-reset concatenation) -- three alternative repair strategies (train the agent to survive; reduce/remove hazards for this diagnostic; concatenate short env sub-episodes) were each considered and rejected in the docstring because each would confound the very EMA dynamics under measurement (either by changing the trained policy, changing the PE-stream's character, or by desynchronizing agent.reset()'s once-per-episode recalibration cadence from real exposure / injecting teleport-artifact PE spikes). New precondition real_exposure_achieved (floor 0.999) operationalizes the fix as a measured, falsifiable check per cell, plus an in-code regression assert that final_global_tick_reached varies across swept STEPS_PER_EP values (would catch a reintroduced early-break defect before a multi-hour run). Smoke test (--dry-run, reduced steps_sweep=(20,40), 8 cells) 2026-08-02: all 8 verdict:PASS, real_exposure_frac=1.0000 in every cell (final_global_tick=59 for steps20 cells = 20*3-1 exactly; =119 for steps40 cells = 40*3-1 exactly), env_done_ticks 34-102 of 60-120 confirming the environment's own termination DID fire repeatedly (consistent with 864's diagnosed ~8-11-tick early death) while the redesigned driver correctly ran through it. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 non-conforming, 0 warnings of any kind. Real cost realizes 864's own originally-stated (but never actually paid) budget: (200+500+1000)*8*2*2=54400 train-only ticks, ~30% of 860's 180000, projected ~21min of pure step time from 860's measured 0.0233 s/step (860 elapsed_seconds=4200.6 for 180000 steps) plus init/optimizer overhead -- estimated_minutes=45 accordingly (864's own pre-registered 40min estimate, +5min buffer since this run now actually executes the full budget). Does NOT block EVB-0454 (SD-076 decision proceeds on V3-EXQ-860 Finding A, untouched by this diagnostic). Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): 864's own autopsy category is measurement_test_design_defect/action:none (instrument repair, not a substrate gap) -- does not count toward SD-076's brake tally per the INSTRUMENT carve-out; 0 prior substrate_ceiling autopsies for SD-076. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): checked via reanalysis_query.py query --readout rv_trajectory_within_episode --claim SD-076 (2026-08-02) against 794/794a/850-h1/850-h2/860/864 -- 0 carry a within-episode trajectory readout at verified-varying exposure (864's own trajectory data is defective, cannot answer the question). Not recoverable -> run. items.title: ARC-062/MECH-309 full-budget replication of V3-EXQ-859: lateral_pfc route_source vs none ablation, MECH-448/449 engagement (~7.7h)
items.note: ARC-062/MECH-309 FULL-TRAINING-BUDGET replication of V3-EXQ-859's lateral_pfc-vs-none route_source ablation (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-859_2026-08-01.md, user-confirmed routing: "chip the full-training-budget (~7.7h) replication now ... rather than deferring the compute-cost judgment call to /governance"). BACKGROUND: V3-EXQ-851 (full ~7.7h, P0=200/P1=90/P2=60, seeds 42/43/44) found MECH-448 (F-eligibility demotion) completely dead (0.0) under modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc', vs robustly live (17.76) under 'cand_world_summary' in matched-stack template V3-EXQ-654j (same seeds). V3-EXQ-859 (cheap ~45min diagnostic, P0=10/P2=10, no P1) compared 'lateral_pfc' vs 'none' at the same seeds to isolate whether route_source itself is causal: MECH-448 was ALIVE in BOTH arms (3/3 seeds each) -- did NOT reproduce 851's collapse under either value. MECH-449 was dead in BOTH arms, matching its deadness in 851. Two readings remained undistinguished: (a) route_source has no causal effect on MECH-448 at all -- 851's diagnosis needs a different explanation; or (b) route_source's effect is training-duration-dependent and only emerges over a longer run, which 859's 45-minute probe cannot detect by construction. THIS RUN: same 2-arm ablation (modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc' vs 'none'), same seeds (42/43/44), same matched-stack config as V3-EXQ-859 (use_candidate_rule_field=True fixed on both arms, USE_F_ELIGIBILITY_DEMOTION/USE_GO_NOGO_CONSTITUTION/USE_DACC/USE_MODULATORY_SELECTION_AUTHORITY/USE_MODULATORY_CHANNEL_ROUTING all matched, identical ENV_KWARGS, identical CRF maturity levers, identical SD-056 online e2 training) but extended to FULL budget matching V3-EXQ-851's own schedule exactly: P0=200/P1=90/P2=60 (350 episodes/cell x 200 steps x 3 seeds x 2 arms = 420000 ticks, ~7.67h on the cloud fleet per 851's own measured elapsed_seconds=27623). P1 (bias-head REINFORCE training) is reused verbatim from V3-EXQ-851's own machinery -- 859 skipped P1 as out-of-scope for its structural-engagement question, but running it here reproduces 851's training schedule structurally, not just numerically, and does not privilege either arm since agent.lateral_pfc exists and trains on BOTH arms regardless of route_source. Primary readout is UNCHANGED from V3-EXQ-859 (NOT a rebuild of V3-EXQ-851's full C1(a-g) readiness gate + C2 committed-class-entropy falsifier apparatus): MECH-448 (f_eligibility_demotion_active_frac + mean f_eligibility_excluded_count) and MECH-449 (go_nogo_active_frac + mean safety+soft suppressions) engagement, latch-cleared on every P2 tick. claim_ids=[] (matches V3-EXQ-859's own convention -- routing diagnostic, not new MECH-309/ARC-062 evidence); experiment_purpose='diagnostic'; supersedes=null (does NOT supersede V3-EXQ-859 -- 859's short-budget result stands on its own terms as a correctly-self-routed 'needs_full_replication' finding, this is a duration-extended follow-up, not a bug-fix correction). Accepted because V3-EXQ-858 (ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-B, a 1200-minute/20-hour 4-rung f_weight attenuation ladder run) is ALREADY sitting suspended pending exactly this question -- the cost of running this once is smaller than leaving that allocation suspended indefinitely on an ambiguous short-probe result. THIS RESULT DETERMINES WHETHER V3-EXQ-858 CAN BE UNBLOCKED: V3-EXQ-858's own matched-stack config presupposes MECH-448/449 are active under lateral_pfc routing, which is exactly what is in question here.
